subject: Re: Updated timeline for the site pages
text:
Good morning,

Thank you for your message earlier this week. I wanted to provide a clearer update because I misread a calendar entry and nearly delayed the wrong milestone. The client call is not until next Thursday, so I now have two extra days to finish the revised copy blocks and send them to you for review. I have already adjusted the layout notes and added captions for the photo placeholders. If the meeting moves again, I can still deliver the first round of updates by Wednesday afternoon, which gives us enough time to correct anything before publication.

One small correction: the handoff I mentioned for the landing page is tied to the analytics tracking, not the image compression. The tracker files are ready, but the compressed images will be delivered with the second batch. I will flag this in the project sheet so the sequence stays clear for everyone.

I also revised the short timeline based on the comments in the shared folder. The only open question is whether the testimonials should appear above or below the pricing table. I can prepare both versions, though the current layout reads more naturally with them below. Please let me know if your side has a preference or any wording constraints. I appreciate the quick note and the flexibility around the calendar mix-up.
